d: Iconic Solar System and deep-space destinations from landmark cinematic science fiction films.

moon.x: Automated lunar farside extraction outpost in Moon mining Helium-3 to power Earth, operated by Lunar Industries clones, and the piracy-ridden frontier gateway Copernicus Base in Ad Astra.
moon.a: sarang lunarindustries sam bell gerty helium3 copernicus adastra

io.x: High-radiation corporate mining facility on Jupiter’s moon Io where Marshal William O’Niel uncovers a lethal amphetamine-smuggling conspiracy.

europa.x: Landing site of the privately funded Europa One expedition investigating hydrothermal vents and bioluminescent aquatic life beneath the cracked ice of Conamara Chaos.

saturn.x: Fleet of immense geodesic greenhouse cargo freighters orbiting Saturn preserving the last specimens of Earth’s extinct forests and plant life.
saturn.a: valleyforge biodome lowell dewey huey louie drone

titan.x: Destination of the manned Gattaca exploration mission celebrating natural human triumph, and the supposed orbital haven colony in Oblivion.
titan.a: gattaca vincent jerome flight titanmission oblivion

neptune.x: Outer Solar System orbital boundary where the antimatter-pulsing Lima Project antenna threatens Earth in Ad Astra, and the reappearance site of the hell-dimension test ship Event Horizon.
neptune.a: limaproject clifford mcbride surge eventhorizon gravitydrive weir

sol.x: Target trajectory of the starship Icarus II carrying a stellar-mass nuclear payload into the dying Sun to reignite its fusion furnace.
sol.a: icarus payload stellar reignite sunshine pinbacker

hip-69673.x: Spectacular red giant star Arcturus passed at close range by the sleeper starship Avalon during its 120-year voyage to Homestead II.
hip-69673.a: avalon arcturus slingshot homestead jim preston

gaia-4330690742322011520.x: Potentially habitable exoplanet Wolf 1061 c, destination of the sleeper colony transport pod in Oxygen.

mars.x: Cydonia Mensae landing site where the Mars-1 and Mars-2 rescue teams discover an ancient artificial face harboring an alien biosphere archive.

b.s: Memorable cinematic destinations across the Solar System and nearby stars, including Sarang Station on the Moon (Moon), Con-Am 27 on Io (Outland), Conamara Chaos on Europa (Europa Report), the Lima Project at Neptune (Ad Astra), the Valley Forge at Saturn (Silent Running), and the Avalon slingshot past Arcturus (Passengers).
b.r: Moon (2009), Outland (1981), Europa Report (2013), and Sunshine (2007)

a: adastra sunshine eventhorizon sarang avalon outland conamara gattaca valleyforge icarus
